statement: The Linux v6.12 Pro path provides four LED controls and battery infrastructure, and its Pro event node translates FF_RUMBLE to one on/off motor request; the Pro module disables MotionPlus probing and does not load Wii Remote accelerometer or IR input modules.

applicability.revision: Wii U Pro; retail revision not measured
applicability.scope: Kernel output and module policy, not verified motor strength, charge behavior or wireless transport.
